description: Governance policy collection scoped to the tenant or a Fabric capacity.

definition_parts.description: Policy-set scope and complete policyRules array
Optional item metadata; use --update-metadata when replacing a definition

flags.--scope: Tenant or Capacity when creating without a definition
flags.--definition: Inline full definition with format Beta
flags.--definition-file: Path to a full definition with format Beta

notes: Policy-rule endpoints are beta and fabio always sends beta=true.
Policy types are ItemCreation and WorkspaceSettingsEditing.
Conditions are discriminated by type: Static uses value; Dynamic uses targetProperty plus an AnyOf or NoneOf predicate with 1-50 values.
Only Allow effects are currently supported.
A maximum of 50 rules per policy type is allowed.
replace-rules-by-policy overwrites every rule for the selected policy.
